sources.fullCitation: U.S. Copyright Office. Catalogue of Copyright Entries, New Series, Part 3: Musical Compositions, vol. 26, nos. 1–12 (1931). Washington, DC: U.S. Government Printing Office, 1932, entries nos. 22781 and 27700, “The Orchestra in Love.” Digitized via Internet Archive.
sources.researchNote: Entry no. 22781 records “The Orchestra in Love”: words and music by Fritz Rotter and B. Kaper, English words by H. Hailey-Simpson, of Great Britain; copyright 18 September 1931, one copy received 21 September 1931, E for. 20550, Chappell & Co. Ltd., London. Entry no. 27700 records “The Orchestra in Love” as a romantic-orchestra fox-trot intermezzo: words and music by Fritz Rotter and B. Kaper, English words by H. Hailey-Simpson, of Great Britain, 4to; copyright 16 October 1931, one copy received 29 October 1931, E for. 20990, Chappell & Co. Ltd., London.
